en: An illustrated historical waterfront scene showing a round city gate tower with a red, conical roof and a large crane arm extending over the harbor. Sailing ships are moored beside the structure, and horse-drawn carts and people stand on the quay. To the left are old town buildings with gabled roofs. The image is oval-framed on a light background. Dutch captions printed below the image read "Oud Nijmegen." on the left and "de Kraanpoort" on the right.
